GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down trailing speed Two Wide With Cover 2 Lengths came Wide approaching Straight but Under Pressure & weakened (vetted - no abnormalities) ( synthetic hoof-filler on 1st time) # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Raced three wide from the 700m without cover. Rider reported when the pace slowed near the 700m the gelding raced keenly and for this reason raced wide without cover from that point. He added that Bustling would be better suited to bigger tracks than the Cranbourne circuit.  A post-race vet exam did not reveal any significant findings

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Raced wide without cover throughout. Near the 400m was brushed by a runner. Approaching the 100m was eased when crowded for room. Post-race vet exam, at the request of the stable – no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Not Bustled Settled Down 4th 3 Wide with a trail 2 Lengths race very much run to suit , out Four Wide Turning for home Under Pressure Soon After Straightening Up , Held Ground to 100m then Couldn'T Go On ! # lame 1/5
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported the gelding slipped on jumping, became unbalanced and lost ground. Std while mnt then travelled comfortably through the early and middle stages, when placed under pressure on straightening, the gelding commenced to lay in and did not fully stretch out in the home straight. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be lame (1/5) in the off foreleg. Stable rep was advised a vet clearance would be required prior to being permitted to barrier trial/race again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After beginning only fairly, shortly after the start was bumped. Near the 900m raced tight. Approaching the 300m shifted out and away from another rnr and bumped. Rdr reported his mnt raced greenly throughout the race and was disappointing in the manner in which it closed off in the home straight. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Co-tnr subsequently reported satisfaction with the post-race condition of the gelding and an endoscopic exam revealed no abnormalities. He added whilst the performance was disappointing, it was the gelding's first start racing in the Sydney direction.
